text:
jordan: opened PR to refresh SDK snippets for streaming + pagination + retries. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/521
leah: thanks. quick checklist?
oscar: Main fixes I spotted:
  - TS example still uses legacy `client.stream()`; needs `client.chat.stream()`
  - Python retry example must include jitter, not just exponential backoff
  - Pagination example needs a short note showing how to persist resume tokens
jordan: Agreed. Keep snippets copy-paste ready.
leah: I'll add a tiny Python helper for jittered backoff (3 lines + comment).
oscar: I'll do the Go file-backed resume token example:
```
// load token
tok, _ := os.ReadFile("/tmp/resume_token")
req.ResumeToken = string(tok)
// after processing
_ = os.WriteFile("/tmp/resume_token", []byte(newTok), 0644)
```
leah: For TS I'll replace `client.stream()` with `client.chat.stream()` and show `for await (const part of stream)` and AbortController usage.
jordan: Also add a short migration blurb: "v1.3: chat streaming moved under client.chat.*; resume_token is opaque and monotonic." Keep it searchable.
doc-bot: lint:docs queued  will comment on PR
oscar: One more: add a sentence advising server-side batching for dedupe-sensitive workloads, and show idempotency note for paginated endpoints.
leah: Pushed Python and TS tweaks.
doc-bot: lint:docs reported 1 warning (line-length) 0 errors  see PR comments
jordan: I'll fix the wrap and merge once warnings clear. ETA today.
oscar: thx all :+1:
leah: LGTM :tada:
